status.en: 12 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 71% more than the week before, most of them in Rumbek, Juba and Abyei.
status.nb: 12 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 71 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Rumbek, Juba og Abyei.

summary.en: Sudanese armed forces carried out a drone strike on Abyei’s Amiet market, killing dozens and injuring many, prompting South Sudan to summon Sudan’s envoy over the attack. A separate drone strike hit a market in the disputed Abyei border region, also causing high casualties. In Ruweng, fresh attacks left nine dead and six wounded, while bodies arrived from the Khor Kaltan killings in Northern Bahr el Ghazal. Communal clashes continued, including 14 deaths between Warrap and Lakes communities and the arrest of a traditional chief over a Juba youth killing. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den sudanske hæren utførte et droneangrep på Amiet-markedet i Abyei, der drepte dusinvis og såret mange, og fikk Sør-Sudan til å innkalle Sudans sendebud over angrepet. Et separat droneangrep rammet et marked i den omstridte grensen mot Abyei, og forårsaket også høye tap. I Ruweng førte nye angrep til ni døde og seks sårede, mens lik ankom fra drapene i Khor Kaltan i Nord-Bahr el Ghazal. Kommunale sammenstøt fortsatte, inkludert 14 dødsfall mellom Warrap‑ og Lakes-samfunnene og arrestasjonen av en tradisjonell høvding over et drap på en ungdom i Juba. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: South Sudanese Civil War
background.extract: The South Sudanese Civil War was a multi-sided civil war in South Sudan fought from 2013 to 2018 between government and opposition forces. The civil war caused rampant human rights abuses, including forced displacement, ethnic massacres, and killings of journalists by various parties. Since the war's end, South Sudan has been governed by a coalition formed by leaders of the former warring factions, Salva Kiir Mayardit and Riek Machar. The country continues to recover from the war while experiencing ongoing and systemic ethnic violence.
